## Purpose
The root route and app shell. It provides the document head and theme boot script, the query provider, the auth gate that decides which chrome a page gets, the app shell (sidebar, header, guarded outlet, progress UI, global run watchers), the 404 page and the error boundary.

## Responsibilities
- **At import:** `installOpTracking()`, so every request reports live progress.
- **Head:**
  - utf-8 and viewport meta; the title "Agentic AI Design Patterns — Control Plane";
  - the description "Design, orchestrate and observe AI agents, tools, workflows and knowledge graphs from one control plane.";
  - og and twitter meta;
  - links: `styles.css`, the icon `/favicon.svg`, and preconnects plus the Google Fonts stylesheet for Rubik 400/500/600 and Space Mono 400/700.
- **`RootShell`:** `<html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>`, with `THEME_BOOT_SCRIPT` inline in `<head>` before `HeadContent`.
- **`RootComponent`:** `QueryClientProvider`, then `AppConfigApplier`, `AuthGate` and `AppToaster` (sonner, positioned by `UI_TOAST_POSITION`, themed, with a close button).
- **`AuthGate`:**
  - public paths render bare;
  - it shows `Splash` until mounted and loaded;
  - a session error shows `Unreachable` ("Can't reach the platform", with "Try again");
  - `/admin/*` needs an admin (else it redirects to `/admin/login?next=…`) and is wrapped in `AdminShell`;
  - **without a user:**
    - an admin may open `/settings` inside `AdminShell`;
    - `/health` redirects an admin to `/admin/health`;
    - `/` shows `LandingPage`;
    - anything else redirects to `/login?next=…`;
  - otherwise `AppShell`.
- **`GuardedOutlet`:**
  - `canOpen`; at "/" without permission it redirects to the first allowed `NAV_ITEMS` entry, otherwise shows `NoAccess(workspace, role)`;
  - on `/settings` without admin rights, shows the amber banner "Read-only: changing platform settings needs a platform admin signed in to the admin console."
- **`AppShell`:**
  - `usePageTransition` on `<main>`;
  - sidebar collapsed state, which follows `UI_SIDEBAR_COLLAPSED` until the user toggles it;
  - a resizable nav (stored under "nav", default 248, range 200–400; 64 px when collapsed), exposed as `--nav-w`;
  - background effects (`app-atmosphere`, `grid-backdrop`) when `UI_BACKGROUND_EFFECTS` is set;
  - Sidebar, AppHeader, `<main>`, TopProgressBar and ActivityTray;
  - outside the shell: BackgroundRuns, ExecutionWatcher and RunQuestions.
- **`NotFoundComponent`:** "404 / Page not found / This route isn't part of the control plane." with "Back to Orchestrator".
- **`ErrorComponent`:** "This page didn't load", plus `reportLovableError` and "Try again" (`router.invalidate` + reset) or "Go home".

## Key elements
`Route`, `AuthGate`, `AppShell`, `GuardedOutlet`.

## Control flow
TanStack root route.

## Data, state and side effects
- Installs the axios interceptors.
- Global listeners through the child components.

## Configuration
UI_TOAST_POSITION, UI_SIDEBAR_COLLAPSED and UI_BACKGROUND_EFFECTS (Settings → Frontend).

## Interactions
- **Uses:** components/layout, runs, activity, admin, auth and landing; lib/auth, theme, uiConfig, gsap and ops/tracker.

## Error handling and edge cases
- An unreachable API is a dedicated screen, not a blank page.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **The server-rendered `<html>` and the live one differ on purpose,** because the boot script sets the theme before hydration.
- **The gate only decides what to show.** The API enforces every rule.
- **`/favicon.svg` is referenced, but the repo's `public/` folder only tracks `robots.txt`,** so the icon probably 404s unless it is added.

## How to rebuild this file
Implement it as described, keeping the gate order.

None.
